Site.Tagline: Custom decks, remodels and everything your home needs.

Hero.Title: Built right.
Hero.Text: Sumlers Construction designs and builds custom decks, remodels kitchens and baths, and takes care of every kind of project around your home.

WhyUs.Title: Craftsmanship you can see. Service you can count on.
WhyUs.Text: We are a family-run crew that treats every home like our own. That means showing up on time, explaining your options honestly and building work we are proud to put our name on.

Items.Title: Licensed & insured
Items.Text: Permits pulled, inspections passed and coverage on every job.

Items.Title: Clear, written quotes
Items.Text: You see every line item before work starts. No surprise invoices.

Items.Title: One crew, start to finish
Items.Text: The people who quote your project are the people who build it.

Items.Title: Clean job sites
Items.Text: We protect your home and leave it cleaner than we found it every day.

Process.Title: A simple, stress-free process
Process.Text: From the first call to the final walkthrough, you always know what happens next.

Items.Title: Free consultation
Items.Text: We visit, listen to what you want and look at the space.

Items.Title: Design & quote
Items.Text: You get a clear plan, materials options and a written price.

Items.Title: Build
Items.Text: Our crew builds it right, with updates along the way.

Items.Title: Final walkthrough
Items.Text: We walk the finished work with you and fix anything you notice.

Services.Title: Custom Decks
Services.Summary: Wood and composite decks designed around how you live outside: multi-level, covered, with built-in seating, lighting and railings that last.

Services.Title: Home Remodeling
Services.Summary: Kitchens, bathrooms, basements and whole-room makeovers, managed start to finish by one crew that cares about the details.

Services.Title: Porches & Exteriors
Services.Summary: Front porches, pergolas, siding, windows and doors that add curb appeal and stand up to the weather.

Services.Title: Repairs & Everything Else
Services.Summary: If it is part of your home, we can help. Rot repair, drywall, framing, punch lists and the projects other contractors pass on.

Testimonials.Quote: Our new deck is the best part of the house now. They showed up when they said they would, kept the yard clean and finished ahead of schedule.
Testimonials.Author: Jennifer R.

Testimonials.Quote: We got three quotes for our kitchen. Sumlers was the only one who walked us through every option without pushing. The result is beautiful.
Testimonials.Author: Mark & Dana T.

Testimonials.Quote: Honest, careful work. They found rot under our old porch and fixed it right instead of covering it up.
Testimonials.Author: Carl W.
